Golfers by year

Source: R/plots.R
plot_annual_golfers.Rd

One point per calendar year, joined by a line. The value is the sum of daily rounds. In the city extract a round is one golfer who played the course. A range-only visit is not included. A year that does not run from January 1 through December 31 is marked with an asterisk.

Usage

plot_annual_golfers(data)

Arguments

data

Daily rows from dobson_operating_daily().

Value

A ggplot object.
